questions.question: Read the alphabet gaps from left to right. Three groups have gaps 1, 2 and 3. Which does not?
questions.explanation: KLNR has gaps 1, 2 and 4. The other three groups have gaps 1, 2 and 3.

questions.question: A grocer makes a group consisting only of pulses. Which item needs a different label?
questions.explanation: Sorghum is a cereal. Lentil, chickpea and pigeon pea are pulses.

questions.question: Manpreet applies one common multiply-then-add rule to the first number of each pair. Which pair cannot belong to the other three?
questions.explanation: The common rule is y = 3x + 2. For 16 it gives 3 × 16 + 2 = 50, not 52; the other pairs fit.

questions.question: Navjot needs a material that allows electric current to pass readily. Three fit; which should she reject?
questions.explanation: Porcelain is an electrical insulator. Graphite, aluminium and copper conduct electricity.

questions.question: Of these four parcel codes, identify the one that is not a perfect cube of a whole number.
questions.explanation: 1728 = 12³, 2744 = 14³ and 5832 = 18³. Since 16³ = 4096, 4098 is not a perfect cube.

questions.question: Within each group, pair the first letter with the second and the third with the fourth. Which group contains a pair that is not alphabetically opposite?
questions.explanation: Opposite positions add to 27. In CXJP, J + P = 10 + 16 = 26; every pair in the other groups totals 27.

questions.question: Three pairs link an institution with the people it primarily serves. Which pair links an institution with its workers instead?
questions.explanation: Nurses work in a hospital; its primary recipients of care are patients. The other pairs name the institutions' residents or learners.

questions.question: Among these animals, which lies outside the reptile class?
questions.explanation: A salamander is an amphibian. A gecko, crocodile and tortoise are reptiles.

questions.question: Apply the alternating-digit-sum test for divisibility by 11. Which number fails?
questions.explanation: For 6315, (6 + 1) − (3 + 5) = −1, which is not a multiple of 11. The other alternating-sum differences are 0, 0 and 0.

questions.question: Compare each three-digit number with the number after the colon. Which pair does not show complete digit reversal?
questions.explanation: Reversing 472 gives 274, not 724. The other second numbers are exact reversals.

questions.question: An alphabetical check requires every letter to lie before the previous one. Which group fails this descending-order check?
questions.explanation: In WQSM, Q to S moves forward rather than backward. Every step in the other groups moves towards A.

questions.question: A gardener groups plants by reproduction through spores rather than seeds. Which plant is misplaced?
questions.explanation: Pine produces seeds in cones. Ferns, mosses and horsetails reproduce through spores.

questions.question: Compare the ratios within these number pairs. Which pair does not share the common simplified ratio?
questions.explanation: 52 × 7 = 364, while 93 × 4 = 372. Each other pair satisfies 7 × first = 4 × second.

questions.question: Four unit names are listed. Which is a derived SI unit rather than an SI base unit?
questions.explanation: Pascal is a derived unit of pressure, equal to newton per square metre. Kelvin, mole and candela are base units.

questions.question: Only one number has its middle digit different from the product of its outer digits. Find it.
questions.explanation: For 354, 3 × 4 = 12, not 5. The other products are 2 × 3 = 6, 2 × 4 = 8 and 3 × 3 = 9, matching their middle digits.

questions.question: The format is XYXY, obtained by repeating a two-letter block. Which code was written in another format?
questions.explanation: LLPP repeats each letter beside itself, an XXYY pattern. The other codes repeat a two-letter block.

questions.question: Select the pair that differs when the relationship is whole followed by one of its constituent parts.
questions.explanation: A librarian is a person working in a library, not a constituent part of the object. Chapters, spokes and petals are parts of the named wholes.

questions.question: Simran separates objects by whether they normally form a real image on a screen. Which optical device cannot do this for a real object?
questions.explanation: A plane mirror forms a virtual image of a real object. The other devices can form a real image on a screen under suitable conditions.

questions.question: Take A = 1 to Z = 26. In three groups the last position is the sum of the first two. Which group fails?
questions.explanation: G + J = 7 + 10 = 17, which is Q rather than S. The other sums are 3 + 4 = 7, 6 + 8 = 14 and 9 + 12 = 21.

questions.question: A number qualifies if it is divisible by the sum of its digits. Which number does not qualify?
questions.explanation: 248 has digit sum 14, but 248 = 14 × 17 + 10. The other numbers divide exactly by their digit sums: 156/12 = 13, 192/12 = 16 and 240/6 = 40.

questions.question: Which shape is outside the group of polygons, even though it is a closed plane figure?
questions.explanation: An ellipse has a curved boundary. A polygon is bounded entirely by straight line segments.

questions.question: A pair links a perfect square with the cube of the same positive integer. Which pair breaks this link?
questions.explanation: 256 = 16², so its partner must be 16³ = 4096, not 4106. The other pairs use bases 9, 12 and 14.

questions.question: A nutrition chart groups food components that can supply usable energy to the human body. Which component is outside that group?
questions.explanation: Water provides no calories. Carbohydrates, fats and proteins can supply energy.

questions.question: Keep only groups that alternate consonant, vowel, consonant, vowel. Which group must be deleted?
questions.explanation: FARK ends in a consonant, K, instead of a vowel. The other groups follow consonant–vowel–consonant–vowel.

questions.question: A qualifying value has the form n(n + 1)/2 for a positive integer n. Which value cannot qualify?
questions.explanation: 66 = 11 × 12/2, 91 = 13 × 14/2 and 120 = 15 × 16/2. Since 91 < 97 < 105, 97 lies between consecutive such values.
